title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 4
paragraphs: After this Histiaeus, acting through a messenger, Hermippus of Atarneus, sent papers to the Persians who were at Sardis, implying that he had already discussed revolt with them. Hermippus, however, did not deliver the papers to those to whom he was sent, but took them and placed them in the hands of Artaphrenes. Artaphrenes, perceiving all that was being done, bade Hermippus carry the papers sent by Histiaeus and deliver them to those to whom he had been sent, and to deliver to him in turn the replies sent back by the Persians to Histiaeus. These things having been discovered, Artaphrenes thereupon put many of the Persians to death.
